primary_contrast.description: combined minus position_stage explanatory MSE; negative favours dynamics

limits: Retrospective use of observed kinematics and familiar P1 test series.
Explanatory fits train on one series and evaluate on the other; they do not retrain or correct wrist decoders.
Conditional pointwise trial-block intervals omit fitting/population uncertainty.
Symmetric derivatives and unknown upstream scaling/filtering do not establish real-time or physical/neural causality.
Jerk and exact geometric region thresholds are exploratory diagnostics.
